interval_years.quote: Licenses or certificates issued under this act shall be renewed biennially according to a schedule established by board rules and regulations.

required.quote: For licensees who have prescriptive authority the board shall require three (3) hours of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances or treatment of substance abuse disorders every two (2) years.

requirements.quote: Submit proof of initial licensure or certification by an examination acceptable to the board, provided that when the applicant secured his or her initial license or certificate, the requirements for licensure or certification included the requirements then necessary for licensure or certification in this state and have submitted proof that the license or certificate has not been suspended, revoked or otherwise restricted for any reason

credential_type.quote: "License" means a current document permitting the practice of nursing as an advanced practice registered nurse, registered nurse or licensed practical nurse

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall: (i) Engage in the practice of nursing or nurse assisting as defined in this act without a valid, current license, certificate or temporary permit

title_protection.quote: No other person shall assume this title or use this abbreviation or any words, letters, signs or devices to indicate that the person using same is a registered professional nurse.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any act inconsistent with uniform and reasonable standards of nursing practice as defined by board rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act inconsistent with uniform and reasonable standards of nursing practice as defined by board rules and regulations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty by a court, entered an Alford plea, or entered a plea of nolo contendere to a misdemeanor or felony adversely related to nursing practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been found guilty by a court, has entered an Alford plea or has entered a plea of nolo contendere to a misdemeanor or felony that relates adversely to the practice of nursing or to the ability to practice nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced fraud or deceit in procuring a license, filing health care information, signing reports, representing authority to practice, or submitting information to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced fraud or deceit: (A) In procuring or attempting to procure a license or certificate to practice nursing or nurse assisting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfit or incompetent to practice nursing by reason of negligence, habits, physical or mental disability, use of drugs, or unsafe practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or incompetent to practice nursing by reason of negligence, habits or other causes including but not limited to: (A) Being unable to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of physical or mental disability, or use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals or any other mind-altering material

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unauthorized possession or use of a controlled substance as defined in the Wyoming Controlled Substances Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any unauthorized possession or unauthorized use of a controlled substance as defined in the Wyoming Controlled Substances Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a nursing or health care discipline license denied, revoked, suspended or otherwise restricted in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license or certificate to practice nursing or nurse assisting or to practice in another health care discipline in another jurisdiction, territory or possession of the United States denied, revoked, suspended or otherwise restricted

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced nursing within the state without a valid current license or temporary permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced nursing or nurse assisting within this state without a valid current license or temporary permit or as otherwise permitted under this act, the Nurse Licensure Compact or the Advanced Practice Registered Nurse Compact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly and willfully failed to report to the board any violation of the act or board rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly and willfully failed to report to the board any violation of this act or of board rules and regulations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found by the board to have violated any provisions of the act or board rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been found by the board to have violated any of the provisions of this act or of board rules and regulations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly engaged in acts beyond the scope of nursing practice or performed acts without sufficient education, knowledge or ability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly engaged in an act which the licensee or certificate holder knew was beyond the scope of the individual's nursing or nurse assisting practice prior to committing the act, or performed acts without sufficient education, knowledge or ability to apply nursing principles and skills

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to submit to a mental, physical or medical competency examination following a proper request by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to submit to a mental, physical or medical competency examination following a proper request by the board made pursuant to board rules and regulations and the Wyoming Administrative Procedure Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a previously entered board order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated a previously entered board order

definition_quote.value: Practice of professional nursing means the performance of professional services requiring substantial knowledge of the biological, physical, behavioral, psychological and sociological sciences, and of nursing theory as the basis for applying the nursing process which consists of assessment, diagnosis, planning, intervention and evaluation.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of professional nursing" means the performance of professional services requiring substantial knowledge of the biological, physical, behavioral, psychological and sociological sciences, and of nursing theory as the basis for applying the nursing process which consists of assessment, diagnosis, planning, intervention and evaluation.

methods_authorized.quote: Nursing practice includes but is not limited to administration, teaching, counseling, supervision, delegation, evaluation of nursing practice and execution of the medical regimen.

drug_authority.value: APRNs may prescribe, administer, dispense or provide nonprescriptive and prescriptive medications including prepackaged medications, except schedule I drugs. RNs and LPNs may administer medications and treatments prescribed by any person authorized by state law to prescribe.
drug_authority.quote: May prescribe, administer, dispense or provide nonprescriptive and prescriptive medications including prepackaged medications, except schedule I drugs as defined in W.S. 35-7-1013 and 35-7-1014

license_tiers.quote: Each applicant who successfully meets the requirements of this section is entitled to licensure or certification as an advanced practice registered nurse, registered nurse, licensed practical nurse or certified nursing assistant, whichever is applicable.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse (APRN)" means a nurse who: (A) May prescribe, administer, dispense or provide nonprescriptive and prescriptive medications including prepackaged medications, except schedule I drugs

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: These skills and services are performed under the direction of a licensed physician or dentist, advanced practice registered nurse or registered professional nurse.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An APRN issued a multistate license is authorized to assume responsibility and accountability for patient care independent of a supervisory or collaborative relationship with a physician.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An APRN issued a multistate license is authorized to assume responsibility and accountability for patient care independent of a supervisory or collaborative relationship with a physician.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: By board rule and regulation, regulate the qualifications, certification, recertification, examination and discipline of nursing assistants and nurse aides.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: "Practice of a certified nursing assistant/nurse aide" means, regardless of title or care setting, the performance of nursing related tasks and services delegated by a licensed nurse.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: Hospitals, nursing homes and other employers of advanced practice registered nurses, registered nurses, licensed practical nurses and certified nursing assistants shall report to the board the names of those licensees or certificate holders whose employment has been terminated voluntarily or involuntarily for any reasons stipulated in W.S. 33-21-146.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Nurse Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into on behalf of this state with all other states legally joining in the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered or a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN) issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: "Alternative program" means a nondisciplinary monitoring program approved by a licensing board
